SELECT CASE WHEN (i.created_at = $3 AND i.xmin::text = $2) OR (i.asset_key IS NOT NULL AND ? || i.asset_key = $2) THEN NULL ELSE i.data END AS data,
          u.id AS owner_id, i.media_type, u.secret_key_hash, i.xmin::text AS version, i.created_at, i.asset_key
   FROM image_objects_202605 i
   JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT id, secret_key_hash, profile_image_id FROM users
     WHERE id = i.owner_user_id AND status = ? OFFSET 0
   ) u ON true
   WHERE i.id = $1 AND (
     u.profile_image_id = i.id
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM posts p
       WHERE p.image_id = i.id AND p.author_id = u.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
     )
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM realmojis r
       JOIN posts p ON p.id = r.post_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
       JOIN users author ON author.id = p.author_id AND author.status = ?
       WHERE r.image_id = i.id AND r.reactor_id = u.id AND r.replaced_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
     )
   )
   AND i.created_at = $3

SELECT p.id FROM posts p
   JOIN posting_windows w ON w.id = p.posting_window_id
   JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id
   JOIN posting_windows current ON current.region = u.region AND current.ended_at IS NULL
                              AND current.local_date = w.local_date
   WHERE p.author_id = $1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
